Container.Name: Odysseus-ChromaDB
Container.Overview:
ChromaDB vector database, the long-term-memory companion for Odysseus.
After installing, set on the Odysseus container: CHROMADB_HOST = your Unraid server IP CHROMADB_PORT = 8100 (or whatever host port you choose below)
No web UI — this is a backend service.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: Host port for the ChromaDB API. Odysseus's CHROMADB_PORT must match.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Vector database storage (Odysseus long-term memory). Back this up. Note: Chroma 1.x images persist to /data (older images used /chroma/chroma).
